designs.prompt: Create one finished square 1:1 Spotify podcast episode cover for PropFirmTrader, at least 1080px square. Follow reference 1's precise premium square series layout: small centered header green authentic PFT logo plus white 'PropFirmTrader', thin white vertical divider, black 'Razvan' in a white rectangular nameplate. Spacious header at y5-11%. Huge centered geometric sans-serif headline on THREE lines y16-44% reading exactly '$158K in' then '2 Weeks' then 'Reversal Strategy'. Black top, soft grey top halo, warm beige/gold gradient behind portraits; subtle vignette bottom. White curved arrow between people points toward Razvan, without covering either face. Photographic realistic editorial cutouts, balanced skin lighting, natural texture, subtle rim separation. Clean hierarchy readable at small scale; no invented badges, no 'verified', no promise, no other text, no Spotify logo, no extra people. Render just the finished single square artwork, no mockup or collage.
